reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Travel Cleansing Set (Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil 20ml+ Heartleaf Quercetinol Pore Deep Cleansing Foam 25m
reviews.text: I bought this Anua cleansing set for my seaside vacation, and it was very convenient to take with me. The travel sizes are perfect for a trip and do not take much space. I really liked both products. The cleansing oil removes sunscreen and impurities very well, and the foam cleanser feels very gentle and pleasant on the skin. My face felt clean, soft, and comfortable after using them. A great set for travel, and I would definitely buy the full sizes.
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢套 Anua 清潔套裝去海邊度假，帶出門真係好方便。旅行裝大小啱晒去旅行，又唔會佔太多位。兩件產品我都好滿意。卸妝油卸防曬同雜質都好徹底，泡沫洗面乳搽上面好溫和、好舒服。兩件用完之後塊面感覺乾淨、柔軟、舒服。旅行必備套裝，我一定會回購大裝。
